contributions.statement: Cap verifier-gated repair retries at about three: 68-84% of successful fixes landed on the first attempt and later attempts added little success at rising cost.
contributions.evidence: §6 Fig. 7: 67.9-83.5% of fixes on attempt 1, diminishing returns afterwards; Figs. 8-10 time/cost. Small textbook Eiffel routines with AutoProof, one run per configuration, no external baseline.

reason: Mostly a tool tour for Eiffel; the attempt-distribution data is the one transferable measurement and supports a small retry cap in any host's loop. The context ablation is confounded.
